1. Damage caused by lightning, an externally originating power surge, abnormal supply, accident, liquid, misuse or unauthorized repair is not a manufacturing defect and is excluded from the manufacturer warranty.
2. Aurelia may require diagnosis to identify the probable cause of the failure.
3. A service report should distinguish the observed symptom from the probable technical cause.
4. Keep replaced parts and cause findings where a warranty or insurance claim may follow.
